name: Tide Chart
description: A day of tide as a smooth water curve, with high and low water labelled, night hours shaded, a now marker riding the curve and the moon's phase.

props.name: points
props.description: Water heights by time in hours from midnight, e.g. 6.7 for 06:42. Include the high and low water times as points: the curve never overshoots the data, so they become its peaks and troughs. Points outside 0 to 24 carry the curve past the edges.

props.name: now
props.description: The current time in hours. A marker rides the curve to it and the header reads the height there.

props.name: phase
props.description: Moon phase from 0 to 1: 0 new, 0.25 first quarter, 0.5 full, 0.75 last quarter. Drawn at the right of the header.

props.name: sunrise
props.description: Sunrise in hours. Hours before it are shaded as night, with half an hour of twilight.

props.name: sunset
props.description: Sunset in hours. Hours after it are shaded as night.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes heights in labels, the tooltip and the table. Defaults to metres with two decimals.

props.name: formatAxis
props.description: Writes the height axis. Defaults to format.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width follows the card.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the legend with the night hours under the plot.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: A title under the horizontal axis. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: A title beside the vertical axis, set sideways. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card, e.g. the place and date.

props.name: value
props.description: The headline. Defaults to the height now.

props.name: caption
props.description: Muted text after the headline. Defaults to whether the tide is rising or falling and the next turn.

props.name: action
props.description: Replaces the moon on the right of the header.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replaces the legend under the plot.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts note and every other prop of a div.
